columns.description: Column definitions in definition order. Pinned columns are drawn first.

onRowsChange.description: Called with the full row list after every edit, fill, paste, cut, clear, delete, undo, or redo.

label.description: Accessible name for the grid. Also names the exported CSV file.

maxHeight.description: Tallest the scrolling area grows before it scrolls, in px.

sort.description: Controlled sort keys in priority order.

onSortChange.description: Called when a header click, Shift-click, or header menu changes the sort.

filters.description: Controlled column filters, keyed by column key.

defaultFilters.description: Starting filters when uncontrolled. The filter row starts open when any filter is set.

onFiltersChange.description: Called when a filter changes or all filters are cleared.

defaultSelectedRowIds.description: Starting checked row ids when uncontrolled.

onSelectedRowIdsChange.description: Called with checked ids in data order.

defaultHiddenColumns.description: Starting hidden keys. Defaults to columns with hidden: true.

onHiddenColumnsChange.description: Called when the columns menu or a header menu hides or shows a column.

defaultPinnedColumns.description: Starting pinned keys. Defaults to columns with pinned: true, or the first column when no column sets pinned.

onPinnedColumnsChange.description: Called when a header menu pins or unpins a column.

onDensityChange.description: Called when the density menu changes.

rowSelection.description: Shows the row gutter with row numbers and checkboxes.

rowNumbers.description: Shows the row number in the gutter. When false the gutter narrows to 40px and its checkboxes always show. With rowSelection off there is no gutter either way.

selectionStats.description: Shows the active cell address and the Count, Sum, and Average of the selected cells in the status bar. Status messages, such as Undo after a delete, show either way.

toolbar.description: Shows the toolbar with search, undo and redo, filters, columns, density, and export.

totals.description: Shows the sticky totals row. It always covers every row the filters keep, including rows inside collapsed groups.

groupBy.description: Controlled group-by column keys, outermost first. Each group row shows a toggle, its value and row count, and a subtotal under every column whose aggregate is not none.

onGroupByChange.description: Called when a header menu starts or stops grouping by a column.

exportFormats.description: Formats Export offers. With more than one, Export opens a menu. xlsx keeps number, currency, percent, and date formats, column widths, a frozen header and pinned columns, bold totals, and groups as outlined rows with SUBTOTAL formulas.

dataSource.description: Loads rows from a server one block at a time as people scroll, instead of rows. Sort, filters, and search are sent with each request. Keep it stable with useMemo. A grid with a data source is read only, does not group, hides select all, and exports only checked rows.

bulkActions.description: Extra actions for checked rows, shown between Export and Delete.

canDeleteRows.description: Shows Delete for checked rows. Deleting can be undone.

exportFileName.description: Export file name without the extension. Defaults to a slug of label.

loading.description: Shows six placeholder rows and sets aria-busy.

emptyMessage.description: Shown when there are no rows at all. Filtered-out rows show "No rows match" with Clear filters.
